text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. sanctions committee ratifies Iraq's oil pricing formula
- Drastic drop in U.S. strategic oil reserves
- U.N. envoy Rolf Ekeus arrives in Abu Dhabi
- Secretary-General Boutros-Ghali says Iraq's oil-for-food deal with U.N. is ready for implementation
- UAE president urges Arab Gulf states to reconcile with Iraq
- Prices plunge and value of Iraqi dinar surges
- Lloyds experts arrive in Baghdad to implement memorandum of understanding
- Presidential office orders police to capture those firing in the air to celebrate Iraq's oil deal with U.N.
- New irrigation project opened in Basra
- U.S. analysts say Iraq's oil deal with U.N. is a prelude for the lifting of the overall sanctions
- France welcomes Iraq's oil deal with U.N.
- Syria urges Iraq's return to international fold to help in defending Arab issues
- Romanian companies seek trade deals with Iraq
- National Assembly speaker receives Russian parliamentary delegation
- Turkish PM calls for a boost in trade with Iraq
(The above were also carried by AL-QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
